samples.rationale: Filtering lands in the right seams: two derived finders on VetRepository (findDistinctBySpecialtiesNameIgnoreCase, with the no-cache rationale documented) and a thin controller that only normalizes and delegates; the shared asRequestedSpecialty helper avoids copy-paste across both handlers, though the blank-means-absent rule is one more small rule sitting in a controller. Tests are behavior-named (theVetDirectoryShouldKeepTheSpecialtyNarrowingAcrossPages), use named constants (RADIOLOGY, prefixOfRadiology) and existing factories, and cover empty/blank/no-match/paging; the HTML-substring assertion on "/vets.html?page=2&specialty=" is brittle, and the JSON surface gets no blank-value test. Docs are unusually complete (ADR, NG-9 narrowing, REQ-VET-003/004, defect row removed), but prd.md still says "ten further questions stay open" after adding two. vetList.html repeats the narrowed/unnarrowed ternary five times.

Reuses the Repository pattern via a derived query (`findDistinctBySpecialtiesNameIgnoreCase`, both overloads) and keeps the controller thin, but `findPaginated`'s null-check branch and `asRequestedSpecialty` put query selection and blank-normalization in the controller — small and mirroring owner search, yet the layer the catalog flags. Tests are behavior-named (`theVetDirectoryShouldMatchTheSpecialtyNameRegardlessOfCase`), name their data (`RADIOLOGY`, `prefixOfRadiology`, `specialtyNoVetHolds`), and cover blank, no-match, case, prefix, and pagination carry-over; against that, new tests stub with Mockito without recording the exception, assert on raw HTML substrings (`"/vets.html?page=2&specialty="`), and skip blank/case coverage on the JSON surface. The five repeated `${narrowed} ? ... : ...` ternaries and the twice-stated caching javadoc are reviewable noise. Documentation is complete: ADR, NG-9 narrowing, REQ-VET-003/004, superseded note, contracts table, and the retired known-defect row all move.

Filtering rides on derived repository finders (findDistinctBySpecialtiesNameIgnoreCase, paged and unpaged) rather than controller-side logic, and the uncached-read choice is justified in the Javadoc. But asRequestedSpecialty puts the blank-means-unfiltered product rule in VetController, which the catalog's Web controller row treats as a fresh violation. Tests are renamed to the BDD school, name their data (specialtyNoVetHolds, prefixOfRadiology, RADIOLOGY), and split real-data matching in ClinicServiceTests from stubbed dispatch in VetControllerTests; the JSON surface, though, is only tested for match and unfiltered cases, never blank/whitespace. The page-link ternary is repeated five times in vetList.html. Docs are complete: ADR, narrowed NG-9, REQ-VET-003/004, retired-id note, contracts table, and the removed known-defect row.
